قَثْرَدٌ and ↓ قُثَرِدٌ and ↓ قُثَارِدٌ and ↓ مُقَثْرِدٌ A man possessing many sheep or goats and lambs or kids: (K:) or possessing much of household-goods, or utensils and furniture, (K,) and of bad articles of this kind. (TA.) See also قُثْرُدٌ ―
-b2- And قَثْرَدٌ Portions of wool, (K,) and of hair, and of soft camel's hair, (TA,) and such articles of householdgoods or utensils and furniture as are not carried away on departing, or migrating, (K,) but are left in the abode. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
